question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is '**comfortably**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage is discussing how a young person must work to live independently and afford essentials like food and housing.
 
• The word 'comfortably' fits the context because it describes living without financial struggles, which matches the idea of becoming self-sufficient.
 
• The other options ('contrasting', 'revolutionary', and 'granting') do not fit the context of living independently or having a stable life.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

Complete Passage: *Childhood is a time when there are few responsibilities to make life difficult. If a child (1) **has **__good parents and they are fed, looked after and loved, whatever they may do, it is improbable that they will ever again in life (2) __**be **__given so much without having to do anything in return. In addition, life is always presenting new things to the child. A child finds pleasure in playing in the rain or in the snow. Their first visit to the seaside is a marvelous adventure. However, a child has their pains; they are not free to do as they wish; they are continually being told not to do things or are being (3) __punished__. Their life is therefore not perfectly happy. When the young individual starts to earn their own living, they become free from the discipline of school and parents, but at the same time they are forced to accept responsibilities. They can no longer expect others to pay for food, clothes and room, but they have to work if they want to live (4) __comfortably__. If they spend most of their time playing about in the way that they used to as a child, they will go hungry. Moreover, if they break the laws of society just as they used to break the laws of their parents, they may go to prison. However, by working, keeping out of (5)_____ and having good health, they can have the great happiness of seeing themselves make steady progress in their job and of building up for themselves their own position in society.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Comfortably**: 'Comfortably' means living in a manner where basic needs are met without difficulty, which fits well with the context of the passage.
 
• **Contrasting**: Refers to showing differences, which is not applicable to the idea of living independently in this context.
 
• **Revolutionary**: Means something groundbreaking or radical, which does not match the passage's focus on working for stability.
 
• **Granting**: Implies giving permission, which does not fit the context of earning a living or being self-sufficient.
